appraisal_events.evidence: « sa conduite à notre égard a été inqualifiable... Ah! j'ai été bien trompé... rien que pour Mme de Guermantes, il n'aurait pas dû faire cela, il aurait dû désavouer ouvertement les Juifs et les sectateurs du condamné. »
appraisal_events.explanation: The duc delivers an extended tirade condemning Swann's Dreyfusard conduct as a betrayal, but the narration undercuts his outrage by listing the trivial, self-serving grounds (good port, club membership) on which the duc's former esteem rested, framing the blame with irony.

appraisal_events.evidence: « Mais le colonel, qui passait pour un bon garçon, n'avait pas l'âme reconnaissante. Il était envieux des splendeurs d'une bienfaitrice qui les célébrait elle-même sans trêve et sans mesure. »
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator directly asserts that despite his reputation as a good fellow, Froberville lacked gratitude and was envious of his benefactress, a plain negative character judgment stated outside any character's speech.

appraisal_events.evidence: « Mme de Saint-Euverte, fidèle à l'affection qu'elle avait eue pour feu le général de Froberville, n'avait pas aidé de toutes façons le ménage, donnant des toilettes et des distractions aux deux petites filles. »
appraisal_events.explanation: Saint-Euverte is credited with genuine, sustained generosity toward the impoverished Froberville family, but the same passage notes she 'célébrait elle-même sans trêve et sans mesure' her own splendors, tempering the praise with a note of self-congratulation.

status_effects.explanation: Within this aristocratic circle, Swann is locally cast as having fallen from a formerly esteemed position due to his Dreyfusard opinions, though the narration's irony toward the duc's reasoning tempers a stronger reading.
The narrator's direct statement that he lacks gratitude and is envious of his benefactress locally diminishes him despite his surface reputation as a good fellow.

She is shown as materially generous and socially secure enough to sustain a dependent family, a modest positive local positioning even though the narrator's irony about her self-praise tempers full endorsement.
